proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Infinite queries
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Create 25 todo tasks; fetch pages 10+10+5 without duplicates. After adding a new task, the previous cursor should return 409 and the client should restart.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: Bound displayed pages and total task payloads. Infinite query caches can grow without limits; trim or evict older pages when appropriate.
